text: Assumption: A FutureInvalidViolation leads to process termination due to the noexcept declaration — is this correct?

norm: a futureinvalidviolation leads to process termination due to the noexcept declaration
assumption: A FutureInvalidViolation leads to process termination due to the noexcept declaration.
rationale: The specification names FutureInvalidViolation in case of an invalid state, but simultaneously marks the signature as noexcept.
